# Figure Catalog

## Analytical figures generated by MATLAB

The main MATLAB script generates five final analytical result figures:

| Figure | Meaning | MATLAB `.fig` source decision |
|---|---|---|
| `F1_comm_vs_N.png` | Communication time versus number of submodules | keep `1.fig` as `F1_comm_vs_N.fig` |
| `F2_scaling_laws.png` | Computing time of control layers versus `N` | keep `5.fig` as `F2_scaling_laws.fig` |
| `F3_utilization.png` | Schedulability utilization `U(N)` | keep `6.fig` as `F3_utilization.fig`; skip `2.fig` because it is another `F3 U(N)` file |
| `F4_feasibility_heatmap.png` | `N_max` heat map by technique and platform | keep `3.fig` as `F4_feasibility_heatmap.fig` |
| `F5_gantt.png` | Gantt chart at selected `N` | keep `4.fig` as `F5_gantt.fig` |

## Deduplication rule

Only one editable MATLAB `.fig` source should be kept for each final result figure. The uploaded files `2.fig` and `6.fig` both identify as `F3 U(N)`, so only the newer `6.fig` is retained in the figure-source plan.

The committed deduplication map is stored in:

```text
results/figures/matlab_figure_sources.md
```
